title: US stocks today: Nasdaq lags on angst over AI spending ahead of earnings reports
description: U.S. markets closed mixed as the Nasdaq declined on chip stock weakness driven by concerns over heavy AI spending, while the Dow rose and the S&P 500 was nearly flat. Falling oil prices offered support, though geopolitical tensions and tariff developments kept investor sentiment cautious ahead of major tech earnings.

title: American Express Q2 profit rises driven by higher spending and fewer delinquencies
description: American Express has indicated an impressive eight percent growth in profit during the second quarter, largely driven by increased spending from card members and a decline in delinquency rates. The surge in sign-ups for the company's premium offerings showcases their effective customer acquisition strategies. However, it's worth noting that expenses saw a twelve percent rise due to marketing initiatives and product updates, marking a notable investment in future growth.

title: ACC Q1 Results: Profit plunges 60% to Rs 147 crore on lower sales
description: ACC Ltd, part of the Adani Group, reported a staggering 60.8% decline in net profit for the June quarter. This drop in profitability can be attributed to a decline in sales volume, resulting in a 7.75% decrease in revenue compared to the previous year. While higher costs impacted earnings, the company noted that premium products gained market share.

title: REC Q1 Results: Net profit dips over 6% to Rs 4,193 crore
description: REC Ltd reported a year-on-year profit decline of six percent for the June quarter, primarily due to lower interest income affecting its consolidated net profit. Additionally, total income dropped compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 4.25 per share and declared a final dividend of Rs 1.55 per share for the past fiscal year.

title: Lodha Developers Q1 Results: Profit jumps 2-fold to Rs 1,373 crore
description: Lodha Developers reported a remarkable 100% increase in net profit for the first quarter, showcasing substantial growth in sales bookings, which rose by four percent to reach Rs 4,630 crore. Their total income has significantly outperformed the same quarter last year, marking the highest quarterly profit in the company's history. With confidence in sustaining a twenty percent CAGR, Lodha Developers is optimistic about long-term profit expansion.

title: V-Mart Retail Q1 Results: Profit surges 40% to Rs 47 crore
description: V-Mart Retail has reported an impressive 40.5% increase in net profit for the June quarter, reaching Rs 47.21 crore, up from Rs 33.60 crore. Revenue from operations surged by 23% to Rs 1,088.81 crore, while total expenses grew by 22% to Rs 1,031.94 crore. The company has also broadened its horizons by launching 15 new store outlets, reflecting its expansive growth strategy.

title: Losing Wall Street binge premium! Why are Netflix shares in a freefall this year?
description: Netflix shares have slumped despite higher revenue and profit as investors worry about slowing growth, weaker guidance and rich valuations. Wall Street is closely watching whether advertising, pricing power and engagement can sustain the streaming giant’s next phase of earnings growth.

title: US stocks today: S&P 500, Nasdaq fall as investors juggle earnings, Mideast risks and tariffs
description: Major stock indices experienced declines as concerns over artificial intelligence spending intensified. New tariffs and escalating Middle East conflict also weighed on investor sentiment. Chipmaker Intel's shares fell despite forecasting strong quarterly results and increased future spending. Geopolitical risks, including U.S. strikes in Iran, caused oil prices to surge significantly. Investors now await key economic data and Federal Reserve policy decisions next week.

title: Bank of Baroda Q1 Results: Profit falls 72% to Rs 1,278 crore on one-off settlement hit
